next.reason: Same. 1985: BLANK WHEN ZERO, JUSTIFIED and PICTURE in a report group entry 'are the same as' the Nucleus clauses. 2023 §2023:13.15.4 GR2: 'the USAGE, PICTURE, BLANK WHEN ZERO and JUSTIFIED clauses are the same clauses as those that are described under the general format for a data description entry', except for the report-group syntax restrictions, which match the 1985 report-group syntax limits. USAGE was already DISPLAY-only in 1985 report groups.
